summary: Fixed the compile errors and warnings in the library and programs, and removed the stray hand-written include/qs/ops.h. Rewrote the makefiles for generated headers (version.h and ops.h), dependency tracking, link order and static linking, flag-change rebuilds, a real make check, and the documented install layout. Verified clean -j8 builds, check, DEBUG=1, an incremental no-op rebuild and install.
